title: Search Quality Analyst
subtitle: Measures and tunes search quality.
lede: Measures and tunes search quality. It compares the fast search cache against the database baseline, runs side-by-side and smoke tests on fixed question sets, studies usage data with seven groups of model prompts, and recommends setting changes that a person can apply or dismiss.
who: A platform lead accountable for whether search finds the right thing
author: Corey James
